decision.rationale: The dispute is within the time limit. TXN-008057 on card CRD-000020 posted on 2026-09-04 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-22, which is 48 days later. The limit is 120 days (time-limits). The posted amount is 33513 cents, and the authorisation AUTH-008251 at Meadowlark Electronics (MER-000032, ELECTRONICS_ONLINE) is also for 33513 cents. Because the two match, there is no difference between the posted and authorised amounts. There is no receipt or quote: no documents are attached, and the cardholder says they do not have the quote. The quoted 217.84 EUR, and the 117.29 EUR claimed as the difference, are only the cardholder's word. Nothing in the records shows a different agreed amount. Under amount-no-receipt, the receipt or order details must be requested from the merchant.

proposed_actions.note: Please send the receipt or order details for the purchase of 335.13 EUR made on 2026-09-03, posted on 2026-09-04. They should show the amount the cardholder agreed to pay and the price quoted for the order.
